title: quercus lusitanica var. pedunculata
intro:
Quercus lusitanica var. pedunculata, commonly known as the Portuguese oak, is a variety of the Quercus lusitanica tree, native to the Iberian Peninsula. It is a deciduous tree that has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties that may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Quercus lusitanica var. pedunculata include its ability to stimulate the immune system, lower blood pressure, and prevent the formation of blood clots. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.

Note: More research is needed to confirm the health benefits and therapeutic actions of Quercus lusitanica var. pedunculata.
